historical_pattern.summary: Coverage-free mutational fuzzing plus delta-debug shrinking. AFL++/libFuzzer are optional drop-in engines when present.

invariant: A parser must not crash on mutated stdin.
prerequisites: parse.py or bind.entry under the target

oracle.success_means: a mutated input crashed the parser

severity_rationale: A crashing mutant is an availability defect and a sanitizer/KLEE candidate.
